subject: FinHealth Private VPC discovery recap
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Porter <jenna.porter@finhealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: FinHealth Private VPC discovery recap

Hi Jenna — great to meet earlier today. Thanks for taking the time. Quick recap from our side and next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Pain points / drivers
- Regulated PHI workloads across several clinical products; must remain in customer-controlled network boundaries (no public internet egress for model traffic).
- Need customer-managed key (KMS/HSM) for model request/response encryption and at-rest model artifacts.
- Audit/logging requirements: 7+ year retention, integration with Splunk, detailed per-request tracing for compliance.
- Some services will require an air-gapped/on-prem option for high-risk data.

Current stack (as discussed)
- AWS (us-east-1) primary; existing VPC architecture with private subnets and VPC endpoints.
- Centralized KMS (arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:xxxxx:key/xxxx) managed by Security.
- Splunk for logging; SSO via Okta.

Success criteria for pilot
- Private VPC deployment that does not require internet egress.
- Customer-managed KMS integration and verifiable key usage logs.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 250ms for 512-token responses; sustained throughput ~50 rps.
- Delivery of audit logs to Splunk and evidence for SOC2/HIPAA controls.

Next steps (owners and timing)
- I’ll share an initial SOW draft and a short security questionnaire (attached) by end of day — Marissa (owner).
- Schedule follow-up call with your infra/security teams to review network connectivity and KMS policies — Jenna to confirm times; Dylan to join for runtime/ops options.
- Confirm which workloads need on-prem/air-gapped and enumerate affected endpoints — Rajiv to provide list.

Attachments: Redwood_PrivateVPC_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (SOW stub), security-questionnaire-finhealth.xlsx
Links: https://secure.redwood.ai/docs/security-questionnaire/finhealth

If I missed anything important from today, please add. Happy to sync with your infra team as early as next week.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Jenna Porter <jenna.porter@finhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <r.menon@finhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinHealth Private VPC discovery recap

Thanks Marissa — this is a good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We operate primarily in AWS us-east-1, but several regulated workloads are routed through our shared services VPC. We require VPC endpoints and strict security groups — no outbound internet access from the subnets that will host model traffic.
- KMS: we use a centralized customer-managed key policy. Any deployment will need to use our KMS keys or an approved HSM; we also require key usage logs to be forwarded to security.
- Logs: we push logs to Splunk; retention policy is currently 7 years for audit records.
- On-prem/air-gap: there are two products that will need an air-gapped option for processing PHI. Not sure if that will be part of the pilot, but we need feasibility confirmation.
- Timeline: we’re targeting a pilot in Q4 (start in mid-November) and, if successful, broader rollout in Q1. Are those timelines realistic for Redwood?

Also, please confirm whether Redwood can run in an environment with zero internet egress and provide a list of required endpoints (if any).

Thanks — Jenna
Director, Cloud Security | FinHealth
jenna.porter@finhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Porter <jenna.porter@finhealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T17:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinHealth Private VPC discovery recap

Thanks Jenna — great notes. Quick replies inline: 

- Zero internet egress: yes, Redwood Private can be deployed in a VPC with no outbound internet access. We support VPC endpoints for control-plane connectivity and can operate via private link/managed connectors if needed. I’ll have Aditya add the minimal required endpoints and IP ranges for your networking team.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed KMS keys and can integrate with your HSM. We will provide key-usage evidence and integrate logs into Splunk via our log forwarder.
- Air-gapped/on-prem: we do offer an on-prem package for fully air-gapped environments; it requires a side-channel for periodic license/metrics sync in our standard model but we can discuss a fully offline installation with legal/security. Aditya — can you confirm the on-prem checklist and a rough timeline for a pilot?
- Timeline: mid-November pilot is feasible for a scoped proof-of-concept (1-2 model endpoints). Full rollout depends on the security review and network validation.

I’ve attached an updated SOW (Redwood_PrivateVPC_SOW_draft_v2.pdf) that includes an on-prem addendum and a high-level pilot plan.

Next proposed actions:
- Aditya to send networking/IP requirements and on-prem checklist — by EOD tomorrow (owner: Aditya).
- Jenna to share list of workloads that must be air-gapped (owner: FinHealth).
- Marissa to schedule follow-up call with infra/security (owner: Marissa) — propose 60-minute slot next week.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Marissa

From: Rajiv Menon <r.menon@finhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jenna Porter <jenna.porter@finhealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-30T17:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FinHealth Private VPC discovery recap

Thanks team — sounds good. I’ll put together the list of air-gapped workloads and network owners by Friday. For the follow-up call, I’m available Tue/Wed next week (Nov 3-4), mornings EST.

On the endpoints question: if you can provide a short list of required outbound endpoints (even just for control plane or telemetry), that will help our network team speed review.

-Rajiv
VP Product Ops | FinHealth
